entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Support.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return this VeloBand.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I start with your name and order number, please?
Sarah Miller. Order is VF55802.
Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling up your account now. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's just... confusing. I don't like it.
I see. When you say confusing, what part of the interface did you find particularly hard to use?
All of it. I expected more from it, you know? It's not intuitive at all. I shouldn't have to read the entire user manual just to figure out how to track my heart rate.
I understand your frustration completely. Things should be straightforward. Let me just check the purchase date and our return policy for you. One moment.
Fine.

Okay, thanks for your patience. I see the VeloBand was delivered on December 15th, which was 22 days ago. I'm just checking our internal knowledge base... and, yes, our policy states that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. You're well within that window, so I can go ahead and process that return for you right now.
About time something was simple.

Of course. I am generating a prepaid return shipping label for you now. I'll send it to the email address we have on file. You just need to print it out, attach it to the original packaging, and drop it at the post office.
Whatever. Just send it.

I've just sent it. You should see it in your inbox shortly. Once our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Sarah?
No.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
